scope: Major visible screens, drawers, overlays, and meaningful empty/error states in the current A.T.O.M shell.

inventory.label: Map workspace shell
inventory.purpose: Provide one persistent map-first planning surface with global run/save context and contextual tools.
inventory.primaryAction: Choose the next workflow tool or run the current plan.
inventory.commonFailureMode: The map remains visible while the active Scenario/Version and result lineage are not.
inventory.discoverability: High for map-first users; medium for Scenario/Version and historical evidence.

inventory.label: Project and scenarios menu
inventory.entryPoint: Header project button labeled Ankara Plan
inventory.purpose: Manage local Projects and expose Scenario/Version actions.
inventory.primaryAction: Open or save the current Project/Scenario/Version context.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Users infer that the menu is the complete Scenario workspace even though detailed Scenario editing lives in Setup.
inventory.discoverability: High for Project; medium for Scenario/Version because the menu is a compact popover.

inventory.label: Plan > Setup
inventory.purpose: Configure planning mode, technology, propagation model, transmit power, and the Scenario workspace.
inventory.primaryAction: Set common planning inputs or save a Version.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Common RF setup and persistence actions compete in the same long drawer.
inventory.discoverability: High for configuration; medium for Scenario/Version lifecycle.

inventory.label: Plan > Inventory
inventory.purpose: Manage local planning cells and per-cell RF profiles.
inventory.primaryAction: Select, place, import, or edit a cell.
inventory.commonFailureMode: A long list and long editor make it difficult to retain list context; bulk editing is absent.
inventory.discoverability: High for technical users; medium for provenance and scenario override semantics.

inventory.label: Simulate > Propagation
inventory.purpose: Configure ray geometry, radius, azimuth, beam width, and optimization entry.
inventory.primaryAction: Run the selected sector or start optimization.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Normal propagation controls are followed immediately by research/reference cards.
inventory.discoverability: High for core RF; low-to-medium boundary between canonical and reference workflows.

inventory.label: Simulate > Experiments
inventory.purpose: Queue parameter sweeps and inspect fingerprints/Pareto comparisons.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Users may mistake a parameter sweep/Pareto job for the canonical Run or optimization.
inventory.discoverability: Medium; the stage location is logical but the distinction from optimization is specialist.

inventory.label: Simulate > Signal surface
inventory.entryPoint: Workflow rail Simulate, subnav Signal surface; map Signal control
inventory.purpose: Generate, load, inspect, and export a received-signal surface for a current RF result.
inventory.primaryAction: Load or generate the current result surface.
inventory.commonFailureMode: A surface is unavailable until a current RF result exists; users must understand the dependency.
inventory.discoverability: Medium-high after a Run; clear empty/loading/error copy supports it.

inventory.label: Analyze > Interference
inventory.purpose: Configure co-channel load, bandwidth, frequency reuse, noise, and grid analysis.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Tool is unavailable before prerequisites and the rail badge carries more meaning than the panel title.
inventory.discoverability: Medium; visible in Analyze but can be disabled.

inventory.label: Analyze > RF Diagnostics
inventory.entryPoint: Workflow rail Analyze, subnav RF Diagnostics
inventory.purpose: Load evidence campaigns and run measurement/material/facade reference diagnostics.
inventory.primaryAction: Load a campaign or synthetic control, then run diagnostics.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Measurement validation, material reference, and specular reflection look like one continuous normal workflow.
inventory.discoverability: Medium for advanced users; overwhelming for ordinary planners.

inventory.label: Analyze > Building entry
inventory.entryPoint: Workflow rail Analyze, subnav Building entry
inventory.purpose: Estimate service just inside representative building facades.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Users may not know whether this is canonical coverage or a derived diagnostic.
inventory.discoverability: Medium; name is concise but domain-specific.

inventory.label: Analyze > 5G Core
inventory.purpose: Run Core Lab scenarios for Xn, N2, N3, sessions, and related lab flows.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Core-network lab concerns are adjacent to spatial RF analysis without an explicit research/lab boundary.
inventory.discoverability: Medium for advanced users; low for ordinary planners.

inventory.label: Review > Results
inventory.entryPoint: Workflow rail Review, subnav Results; header result summary
inventory.purpose: Inspect the latest RF operation, optimization, interference, comparison, and candidate views.
inventory.primaryAction: Choose a result view and inspect metrics/map evidence.
inventory.commonFailureMode: The current result is not persistently identified by Version/Run; tabs wrap at 1024px.
inventory.discoverability: High after running; medium when a user needs historical context.

inventory.label: Review > Run history
inventory.entryPoint: Workflow rail Review, subnav Run history; linked from Scenario revision detail
inventory.purpose: Inspect durable local simulation and optimization records.
inventory.primaryAction: Select a Run and inspect or reopen its source.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Empty state tells the user to select a Run when no Run exists; implementation terms leak into the default copy.
inventory.discoverability: High under Review; contextual links improve expert workflows.

inventory.label: Review > Data
inventory.purpose: Explain dataset confidence, installed packs, model assumptions, measurement validation, and calibration.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Data, model assumptions, validation, and calibration are one long panel with different ownership levels.
inventory.discoverability: High under Review; conceptual grouping is low once opened.

inventory.label: Review > Report
inventory.entryPoint: Workflow rail Review, subnav Report; Run History detail
inventory.purpose: Generate planning outputs and revisit retained Reports.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Artifact/hash/generator terminology makes a user-facing Report task feel like storage administration.
inventory.discoverability: High under Review; medium from a specific Run unless user sees Generate report.

inventory.label: Map feature inspector
inventory.entryPoint: Click a cell, building, gap, path, interference point, measurement residual, or recommendation on the map
inventory.purpose: Show contextual spatial evidence without leaving the map.
inventory.commonFailureMode: The selected visual feature can be understood without knowing whether it represents current, historical, or diagnostic data.
inventory.discoverability: High by direct map interaction; status lineage is medium.

inventory.label: Global status, error, and undo states
inventory.entryPoint: Triggered by persistence, run, dataset, or application events
inventory.purpose: Communicate progress, errors, warnings, save state, and reversible deletion.
inventory.primaryAction: Read the message and take the provided retry/undo/repair action.
inventory.commonFailureMode: Global messages can state an implementation error without naming the affected Project/Scenario/Run.
inventory.discoverability: High when visible; interpretation varies by message.

coverageNotes.primaryWorkspace: Map stage is persistent across all entries.
coverageNotes.routeNote: All screens are application states under /; none is a separate client route.
coverageNotes.recommendedNextAuditJoin: Join every current result and historical detail to explicit Project/Scenario/Version/Run identity before changing panel layout.
